purpose.summary: This is a batch COBOL program that generates medical insurance billing claim documents (seikyu-sho / 請求書) for inpatient care under the Japanese national health insurance system, specifically for Aichi/Tokushima prefectural public expense medical fee billing (insurance numbers 181, 281, 381, 481, 182, 282, 183, 283, 184, 284, 185, 285). It reads indexed claim files, applies fee calculations, and produces printed output via the JMA ORCA receipt software framework.

verdict.notes: The file was decoded as latin-1 but the Japanese comments are almost certainly EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoded, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The program is part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source Japanese medical receipt software suite. The truncated source shows only the first ~16KB of a ~97KB file (2269 lines total); the PROCEDURE DIVISION logic beyond the initialization section is not visible but the structural indicators (76 PERFORMs, 58 CALLs, 5 GOTOs) confirm a substantial production batch program.
